rules: One primary action per local decision area
Destructive actions use danger semantics, never cipher
Do not use sensitive amber for generic input focus
Labels remain visible; placeholder is not a label

tables.borders: horizontal or full grid only when data needs it
rules: Do not tint entire pseudonymized rows green

dropzone.style: neutral dashed border only while empty/dragging
rules: Supported types come from actual product config
Use for focused interruption, not normal settings navigation

cards.rule: Use only for actual objects or grouped controls. Prefer rows/sections for narrative marketing content.
